name: growthub-governed-console
description: Agent-facing operating console for governed Growthub workspaces in Codex: 14 read/dry-run/hand-off MCP tools over the workspace metadata graph, plus operator skills for the governed mutation boundary. Read + dry-run + governed hand-off — never a mutation tool.

interface.shortDescription: Operate governed Growthub workspaces from Codex
interface.longDescription: Use the Growthub Governed Console in Codex to read workspace topology, traverse the metadata graph, simulate blast radius, dry-run patches through preflight_patch, and hand off exact governed mutation calls without adding a direct mutation tool.
defaultPrompt: Describe this Growthub workspace and its readiness.
Simulate the blast radius before changing this workspace.
Dry-run this workspace patch and return the governed next call.
